description: MCP impersonation and namespace confusion detector daemon. Reads all servers from mcp_server_registry via ws_query. Builds a canonical name index. Detects: (1) Namespace squatting: @modelcontextprotocol/server-X vs modelcontextprotocol-server-X (missing scope), (2) Homoglyph attacks: replace o->0, l->1, rn->m, use similarity_scorer.name_similarity, (3) Prefix/suffix injection: mcp-postgres-official vs mcp-postgres (appended legitimacy words), (4) Reversed scope: server-filesystem-mcp vs mcp-server-filesystem, (5) Hyphenation variants: filesystem vs file-system vs file_system. For each detected pair: compute impersonation_confidence score 0-100. If confidence > 70 AND suspect package has fewer downloads: ws_write mcp_threat_associations {threat_type=impersonation_attempt, severity=HIGH, evidence=suspect_name+target_name+similarity_score}. Poll 86400s. Heartbeat.
